output.question: What are Alphabet's latest earnings results?
output.answer: Alphabet's latest reported results are for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, filed October 29, 2026. Revenue was $127.577 billion, operating income was $40.576 billion, net income was $26.468 billion, and diluted EPS was $2.12. Google Cloud revenue was $15.157 billion for the quarter. [SEC filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000084/goog-20260930.htm)

key_facts.fact: Alphabet reported $127.577 billion in revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026.
Alphabet reported $40.576 billion in operating income for the three months ended September 30, 2026.
Alphabet reported $26.468 billion in net income for the quarter and $26.170 billion in net income available to common stockholders.
Diluted net income per common share was $2.12 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Google Cloud revenue was $15.157 billion for the three months ended September 30, 2026.
